title: Explicit bilinear Hom extension under scalar localization
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, C and D preadditive R-linear categories, and T : C × C ⥤ D additive and R-linear in both partial functors. Use raw scalar localization [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization]. For p ∈ R and objects M,M′,N,N′ of C, there is a unique bilinear map over R[1/p] from R[1/p]⊗R Hom(M,M′) and R[1/p]⊗R Hom(N,N′) to R[1/p]⊗R Hom(T(M,N),T(M′,N′)), sending (s⊗f,t⊗g) to st⊗T(f,g). It is constructed explicitly using the tensor-product base-change isomorphism.

proof.text: Write T(f,g) as T(f,id) followed by T(id,g). Additivity and scalar compatibility of the partial functors make this map R-bilinear. Lift it to a linear map on the tensor product. Base change this linear map and compose with the inverse distributivity isomorphism (S⊗M)⊗S(S⊗N) ≅ S⊗R(M⊗RN), where S=R[1/p]. Curry the result. The base-change formulas give the stated product of scalar numerators. For uniqueness, extensionality for base-changed modules in each variable reduces equality to 1⊗f and 1⊗g, where the required formula agrees.

theorem wfBilinearScalarHom_spec {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    {C D : Type*} [Category* C] [Preadditive C] [Linear R C]
    [Category* D] [Preadditive D] [Linear R D]
    (T : C × C ⥤ D)
    (ht : (∀ M, ((Functor.curry.obj T).obj M).Additive ∧
      ((Functor.curry.obj T).obj M).Linear R) ∧
      ∀ M, ((Functor.curry.obj T).flip.obj M).Additive ∧
        ((Functor.curry.obj T).flip.obj M).Linear R)
    (p : R) (M M' N N' : C) :
    ∃! b : (Localization.Away p ⊗[R] (M ⟶ M')) →ₗ[Localization.Away p]
        (Localization.Away p ⊗[R] (N ⟶ N')) →ₗ[Localization.Away p]
        (Localization.Away p ⊗[R] (T.obj (M, N) ⟶ T.obj (M', N'))),
      ∀ (f : M ⟶ M') (g : N ⟶ N') (s t : Localization.Away p),
        b (s ⊗ₜ[R] f) (t ⊗ₜ[R] g) = (s * t) ⊗ₜ[R] T.map (Prod.mkHom f g)
